about: Produced music for showtime videos, curated for video use and fetched on first use from each creator's own host (never re-hosted). Every entry pins the file (bytes + sha256) and the exact credit its license asks for; `audio mix` writes it into credits.txt and share.txt. Field reference and the quality gate: lib/st/audio/music.py. Every track was downloaded and measured (format, bandwidth, noise, clipping, loudness, silences, stereo, rhythm, ending) and passed the gate below; moods come from the creators' descriptions, energy/shelf/tempo were checked against the measurements. `audio music veto` still hides a track you dislike.

quality_gate.method: each pinned file decoded in full; ffprobe, EBU R128 (ffmpeg ebur128), numpy/scipy spectra, LPC-residual click detection and onset analysis

notes.bandwidth: highest frequency where the long-term spectrum of the loud passages is within 50 dB of its 200 Hz-4 kHz level (78 rpm discs and AM radio read 5-8 kHz; a 128 kbps MP3 about 16)
notes.steady_hiss: the 8-16 kHz level in 23 ms frames never dips more than 4 dB (a noise bed, not cymbals) and sits above -50 dB relative to the loud passages
notes.crackle: short LPC-residual clicks away from musical onsets; counted as surface noise only in a recording that also has under 15 kHz of bandwidth or a steady noise floor above -60 dB (sharp synth attacks trip the click counter too)
notes.ending: clean: the last loud moment (within 6 dB of the body) is 1-7 s before the end; soft: more (a fade or quiet outro); cut: loud within the last second, or the last 0.5 s within 20 dB
notes.quiet_intro_s: seconds until the 1 s level first reaches the body's 90th percentile minus 18 dB
notes.highlight_s: start of the loudest sustained 30 s, moved back to where the level first rises within 6 dB of it (at most 15 s); a mix can start there with "offset": "highlight"

buckley.name: Scott Buckley
buckley.attribution_format: '{title}' by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au
buckley.content_id_note: His library is protected by Smart Content ID: a YouTube video whose description lacks the credit gets an automatic claim, which is lifted at https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/library/copyright-claims-release/ once the credit is added. On YouTube the credit must be in the description, not only in the video.
restrictions: use it synchronised with other media (a video); never re-upload or sell the audio on its own
never submit it (or a video's soundtrack) to Content ID or other fingerprinting services
his orchestral remixes of other composers' themes are not CC BY; none are in this catalog

fetch.rule: one track per user request from the track page's own MP3 link; never bulk (his hosting has limited bandwidth, so there is no zip and we do not mirror)

incompetech.name: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
incompetech.attribution_format:
{title} Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
incompetech.content_id_note: No Content ID registration is known for this music; if a third party claims a video, dispute it with the CC BY 4.0 license and the credit.
restrictions: the credit must be where viewers can find it (description, credits)

fetch.rule: direct MP3 links (mp3-royaltyfree/<title>.mp3), one per user request

wikimedia.name: Public-domain and CC0 recordings on Wikimedia Commons (Musopen, US military bands, others)
wikimedia.content_id_note: Public-domain recordings are sometimes claimed by mistake; dispute a claim with the recording's public-domain or CC0 status (its Commons page).
restrictions: no credit is required; a courtesy line is written to credits.txt

fetch.rule: the Commons original-file URL; a descriptive User-Agent (SHOWTIME_CONTACT adds a contact) and back-off on HTTP 429, as Wikimedia asks

archive.name: CC0 albums on the Internet Archive (Komiku, Loyalty Freak Music)
archive.content_id_note: No Content ID registration is known for these CC0 albums.
restrictions: no credit is required; a courtesy line is written to credits.txt

fetch.rule: archive.org/download/<item>/<file> links of items whose metadata licenseurl is CC0
